name: bucket one side by key, then probe with the other
mechanism: build a hash table on the join key from the smaller collection, then scan the larger one probing the table for matches

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Hash join' in section Database algorithms:

requires: memory for the build side (or partitioning to disk)
fails_when: only equality conditions; skewed keys overflow buckets
